survey_expectations.institution: Central Bank of the Republic of Uzbekistan
survey_expectations.quarterly_aggregation: arithmetic mean of three monthly national values
survey_expectations.composite: equal-weight mean of household and business aggregates

expert_expectations.institution: Central Bank of the Republic of Uzbekistan

policy_rate.quarterly_aggregation: calendar-day-weighted mean of official event rates

neutral_real_rate_benchmark.paper: Natural Rate of Interest in Uzbekistan
neutral_real_rate_benchmark.interpretation: literature benchmark range; not a time-varying current-sample estimate

transformations.ex_ante_real_policy_rate: quarterly policy rate minus quarterly mean 12-month expected inflation
transformations.central_stance_gap: ex-ante real policy rate minus 4.0 percent neutral benchmark

limitations: Survey expectations are not model-consistent expectations.
The equal-weight household/business composite is a transparent sensitivity convention, not an estimated optimal weight.
The neutral-rate range is uncertain and does not capture time variation after the working-paper sample.
The expert series is too short for estimation and is kept separate.
The expectations-based credit equation is not eligible for promotion without rolling forecast evidence.
